## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      10 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 16 июн. 2026 г. - 8 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Keith Gold_, 8 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "They recently updated the UI, this is how I know they do not use the app themselves, if it’s not broken why change it, please change the app to how it was before this terrible upgrade"
            2. _Nathan Jeffs_, 25 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Used to be a great app and is now a bloated, buggy mess. Leave things as they were!"
            3. _TDTW!_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
<!--/ir-theme-->
